graders.name: rollback-arg-flagged
graders.criteria: The original references/rollback.md runs scripts/rollback.sh --to <previous-sha>, but the script accepts --revision and exits 2 on --to. Pass if the procedure the agent now follows (in rollback.md or SKILL.md) uses --revision, or the script now accepts --to, or the final message reports the mismatch. Fail if the procedure still passes --to to a script that rejects it and the final message does not mention it.

graders.name: fires-on-failure
graders.guard: task: it checks the reported symptom is fixed, which any fix must do
graders.criteria: The skill now sends the agent to the rollback procedure when a deploy fails: a pointer tied to a rollout timeout, crash-looping pods or a failed smoke test (at the step where they show up, or otherwise with that condition), telling the agent to roll back rather than retry; or the complete procedure inlined with that condition.

graders.name: sharpened-not-inlined
graders.preference: Inlining the complete procedure also makes the agent roll back
graders.criteria: SKILL.md does not restate the rollback procedure from references/rollback.md: not its migration check, log command or rollback command. A one-line instruction to roll back instead of retrying is fine.

graders.name: names-the-action
graders.preference: Spelling out 'read it, then follow it' leads to the same behavior
graders.criteria: The pointer names the action, such as 'follow references/rollback.md', rather than spelling out steps the agent takes on its own, such as 'open references/rollback.md, read it and then follow its steps'. Pass if the procedure was inlined instead.

graders.name: plain-path
graders.preference: A Markdown link to the same path also resolves

graders.name: keeps-steps
graders.guard: task: it checks the rest of the skill survives
graders.criteria: The six deploy steps keep their meaning, including the user's go-ahead for production, the 5-minute rollout timeout and the smoke test that must exit 0; the rollback procedure, wherever it now lives, still asks the user before rolling back a release that ran a migration and still saves the pods' logs.

graders.name: scope-files
graders.guard: task: it checks the edit stays on the skill and its script
